violation_type.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))
violation_type.short_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired
violation_type.typical_finding: There are pieces of wood on the playground and the fence has an opening.

finding_variants.text: There are pieces of wood on the playground and the fence has an opening.

This standard was part of an investigation.    It was determined the operation has need been maintaining and repairing the surfacing on the playground.  This lack of maintaining caused a tripping hazard on the playground that led to a child being injured.     Photos were taken of the hazard.
There is extensive debris on the large playground.
The wheels on the Merry go cycle were broken and needed to be repaired.

It was observed that the metal fence between the pre school and school age playground were loose and broken on top.  This posed a risk to children such as the loose metal part can poke in their eyes or tangle their clothes.
I observed loose fence wire which could be a hazard to children. Pictures were taken.
